items.tldr: Harvard study of 725K engineers: AI coding agents added 30% more code but zero more finished tasks — review time rose 49%
items.tldr_zh: 哈佛研究 725,000 名工程师数据：AI 编码 agent 让代码量涨了 30%，但完成的任务数没有显著增加——审查时间涨了 49%
items.take: The productivity bottleneck was never 'not fast enough to build' — it's 'not fast enough to judge.' AI accelerated production. Who accelerates judgment?
items.take_zh: 生产力的瓶颈从来不是「做得不够快」，而是「判断得不够快」——AI 加速了生产，谁来加速判断？

items.tldr: Amazon in talks to acquire AI startup Decart for ~$7B; AMD also acquired World Labs
items.tldr_zh: Amazon 正洽谈以约 70 亿美元收购 AI 初创公司 Decart；同期 AMD 收购了 World Labs
items.take: When big companies acquire to patch their AI gaps, are they buying technology — or insurance against being left behind?
items.take_zh: 当大公司用收购来补 AI 短板，它们买的是技术，还是「不被落下」的保险？

items.tldr: Depression may not be one disease — at least 5 distinct brain activity patterns hide under the same diagnosis
items.tldr_zh: 研究发现抑郁症可能不是一种病，而是至少 5 种不同的大脑活动模式藏在同一个诊断标签下
items.take: If five different things hide under one label, are we treating the disease, or the label?
items.take_zh: 如果一个标签下藏着五种不同的东西，那我们治疗的到底是病，还是标签？
